company.name: Parallel
company.shortDescription: Parallel develops a suite of agents and tool APIs for building AI that accesses and utilizes the open web.
company.description: Parallel develops web-based infrastructure and APIs designed to enable artificial intelligence systems to access, process, and act on information from the open web. Its platform provides tools such as search, extraction, task execution, and monitoring APIs that allow AI agents to perform complex, multi-step research and data retrieval workflows. The company focuses on building systems that combine data retrieval, computation, and reasoning into unified outputs, emphasizing verifiable results and traceable sources. Its technology supports use cases such as structured data generation, continuous web monitoring, and automated dataset enrichment using real-time web data. Overall, Parallel Web Systems is oriented toward creating infrastructure that enables AI agents to interact with the web programmatically rather than through traditional human browsing patterns.
